description: Launch sites. Geodetic latitude and east longitude on WGS84 (degrees), height above the ellipsoid (m). Azimuth limits are inertial-launch-azimuth ranges, degrees clockwise from north, sweeping clockwise from azimuthMinDeg to azimuthMaxDeg.
coordinateSource: Pad coordinates as published on the Wikipedia article for each pad (which cite the operators / FAA documents); rounded to ~1e-4 deg (~10 m). Heights are approximate (pads are within tens of metres of sea level) and do not matter at the km level.
azimuthSource: Range-safety azimuth corridors. Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg: the commonly quoted Eastern Range 35-120 deg and Western Range ~147-201 deg corridors (e.g. Larson & Wertz, Space Mission Analysis and Design, 3rd ed., launch-site table). Kourou: the -10.5..93.5 deg corridor quoted in the Ariane 5 User's Manual. Others: APPROXIMATE, inferred from published mission inclinations of each site, not from range documents; flagged with azimuthApproximate=true.
